correctness.rationale: An exact calculation of the two weighted coordinate prox maps yields T_s. The two-period matrix has trace 2p^2-p(1-p)(q+1/q), determinant p^2. The quadratic Schur criterion yields an iff; equality gives eigenvalue -1 and a strict violation gives an eigenvalue <-1. The algebraic identity K(p)=6+(3p-1)^2/[p(1-p)] gives the sharp uniform contrast. Symbolic and rational certificates are attached; finite samples are not invoked as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The recent variable-metric proximal method explicitly needs controls on metric variation. The result provides a sharp and optimally small switching contrast that defeats the otherwise convergent stationary iteration even when all metrics remain bounded SPD and the local decrease test is automatically met. It distinguishes safeguarded global convergence from a concrete unsafeguarded instability on the smallest nontrivial convex feasibility problem.
